content.title: BASF Buys Noble Seeds to Boost Indian Vegetable Seed Footprint
content.summary: BASFY has agreed to acquire Noble Seeds, expanding Nunhems' reach in India and adding cauliflower and radish to its vegetable seed portfolio.

content.title: Albemarle Shares Rally 81% in 3 Months: What's Driving the Stock?
content.summary: ALB has surged 81% in three months as forecast-topping earnings, Energy Storage volume growth and cost cuts offset pressure from weak lithium prices.

content.title: BASFY and ADAMA Partner to Advance Gilboa Fungicide in Europe
content.summary: BASF teams up with ADAMA to speed Gilboa fungicide rollout in Europe, offering a new mode of action as farmers face resistance and regulatory pressure.

content.title: Here's Why You Should Retain CF Industries Stock in Your Portfolio
content.summary: CF gains from strong global nitrogen demand and higher prices, supporting revenue and cash returns, even as rising natural gas costs pressure margins.

content.title: NEM to Sell Fuerte Shares Through Secondary Transaction Agreement
content.summary: Newmont plans to sell 6.77M Fuerte shares at C$4.35, raising about C$29.5M and cutting its stake to roughly 19.5% after the deal.

content.title: Celanese Extends Debt Maturities Through $1.4 Billion Refinancing
content.summary: CE completes a $1.4 billion refinancing to push out maturities, cuts near-term debt and modestly lifts its net borrowing rate.

content.title: PRM Prices $550 Million Senior Secured Notes to Fund Acquisition
content.summary: PRM prices $550M of 6.250% senior secured notes due 2034, with proceeds and cash on hand set to fund the planned MMT acquisition.

content.title: BASF and OQEMA Ink Distribution Deal in Central and Eastern Europe
content.summary: BASFY partners with OQEMA to expand distribution of polymer dispersions and additives across Central and Eastern Europe starting Jan. 1, 2026.

content.title: PPG Secures REDCert2 Certification for Two European Plants
content.summary: PPG earns REDCert2 certification for Amsterdam and Soborg plants, validating mass-balance use of sustainable inputs and boosting European coatings credibility.
